title: Natural-number addition is commutative
description: For every two natural numbers a and b, a + b = b + a. Published Lean core theorem Nat.add_comm. The market commits to the exported proposition; source remains reproducible metadata.
source:
import Init

namespace Oncm

-- Published theorem used for the small end-to-end fixture:
-- Lean core Init/Data/Nat/Basic.lean, Nat.add_comm.
def goal : Prop := ∀ a b : Nat, a + b = b + a

theorem solution : goal := Nat.add_comm

end Oncm

title: Zero equals one
description: A deliberately false formal statement. Its Lean core refutation Nat.zero_ne_one demonstrates genuine NO settlement.
source:
import Init
namespace Oncm
-- Lean core proves that zero differs from one.
def goal : Prop := (0 : Nat) = 1
theorem solution : ¬ goal := Nat.zero_ne_one
end Oncm
